versions.content: Support of BSW Module clusters Type: valid Description: Support the description of BSW module clusters which implement several BSW modules. Rationale: AUTOSAR allows integrating several BSW modules (or even the whole BSW including the AUTOSAR Services) in a single cluster, treating this BSW cluster as one entity. It must be known how the cluster interacts with other modules / clusters in order to integrate it. Tests for clusters must know what parts (operation signatures and configurable functionality) are actually supported by the object under test. Dependencies:  Use Case: Delivery of complete COM stack in a single implementation. Delivery of the whole AUTOSAR BSW in a single implementation. Supporting Material: 
